svg.title: 3B — Full-radius takeoff with offset transition
svg.desc: Individual fitting. Prepared from a tight approved-source crop after full-assembly attempts changed the geometry. Offset transition, distinct tall curved takeoff neck, and outlet rim compared visually against the source crop. Upstream context is represented by two short parent side-wall strips as a cutaway, rather than a fully closed trunk volume. High-resolution raster in SVG.
